title: GPT-5.2 responses unblocked
summary:
Three fixes: GPT-5.2 response blocks, a cramped API keys table, and browser-based Usage CSV downloads.

The `openai-large` GPT-5.2 endpoint moved to Sweden Central to address content-policy blocks that prevented responses.

The API keys table is more compact, with single-line headers and no horizontal scrolling. The Last Used column was removed.

Enter’s auth and dashboard endpoints now expose the `Content-Disposition` header to browser code, addressing a permission error when downloading Usage CSV files.
